meta.parent_method: largest overlap with one SF analysis neighbourhood or Peninsula city/unincorporated group
meta.geometry: H3 polygons clipped to SF / northern Peninsula land through SFO; <1000 m² coastal slivers omitted
meta.matching_point: H3 centre, or representative land point for coastal clipped cells
meta.null: measurement unavailable, never a zero, pass or failure

street_grade_pct.resolution: 40 m windows along official streets; ~10 m DEM
street_grade_pct.method: length-weighted median; p90 and >10% street share retained
street_grade_pct.coverage: at least 100 m measured streets and 75% valid street length

access.resolution: distance from representative point to mapped geometries
access.method: straight-line metres, not walking routes; no entrance/barrier model

incidents_per_km2.period: see crime_grid meta; not an independent H3-9 observation

zip_asking_rent.method: whole-ZIP Zillow index; never a cell-specific rental estimate

residential.resolution: park polygons and addressed residential-class street evidence
residential.method: true=supporting street evidence; false=95%+ park without supporting streets; null=unverified

meta.regional_extension: Legacy fields describe the original extract; see regional_coverage.json and manifest regional_study for extended source coverage and dates.
